title: Abazinikele Abathembisiwe
intro: Umprofethi ohlonishwayo wahamba phakathi kwabantu, ebabizela eqinisweni. Abaningi baphenduka ngenkani, kodwa iqembu elincane elizinikele laphendula ubizo futhi lazibophezela ngenhliziyo yonke. Bavivinywa ngokungabaza futhi baba nesibindi sokufuna ukondliwa kwasezulwini. Ukuzinikela kwabo okungantengantengi kwaba yisifundo esingapheli sokholo. Babengobani?
clues: Sasiyiqembu elincane elasukuma ukusekela umsebenzi ongcwele ngesikhathi sokungakholwa okwandile.
Umprofethi ohlonishwayo weza wasibiza ukuba sibe ngabangane egameni lika-Allah.
Lapho umprofethi ebuza ukuthi obani ababezoba abasekeli bobuNkulunkulu, saphendula ngaphandle kokungabaza.
Sasinesibindi sokucela idili eliyisimangaliso elethulwa livela ezulwini ukuze siqinise izinhliziyo zethu.
Umprofethi wethu wasikhumbuza ukuthi sihloniphe u-Allah uma singamakholwa eqiniso, kodwa isicelo sethu sokuthobeka sahlonishwa.
Sasiyiqembu elizinikele elizinikele elathembisa ukholo oluqinile kanye no-Isa, indodana kaMaryam.

Uyalwa ukuba asindise ikamela lensikazi eliyisimangaliso
trial.answer: Ukucelwa ukuba ngibe ngabasekeli benhloso ka-Allah

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
